fact: The National Bureau of Standards Act, 2012 establishes the National Bureau of Standards as a body corporate (s.5) with the function of formulating, adopting and endorsing standard specifications as South Sudan standards (s.8), though the captured text names no standard on information technology, software or data; the Act gives no date beyond 2012, so the year is the document's published date.

The South Sudan National Bureau of Standards (SSNBS) is described as operating, with a technical manager speaking for it at the World Metrology Day event on 2026-05-20; the article does not say what law or decree set it up.
